title: EVALUATING RACE AND SEX DIVERSITY IN THE WORLD'S LARGEST COMPANIES USING DEEP NEURAL NETWORKS
models_tested: CNN with VGG-16 architecture (from Rothe et al., 2016)
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it was not a variable included in the study. The analysis is strictly focused on race, sex, and age.
